results.title: Liek Hou ends 12-year wait for his third Asian Para Games doubles gold with Faris
results.description: KUALA LUMPUR: After 12 long years, national para shuttler Cheah Liek Hou has managed to secure his third Asian Para Games gold medal in the men's badminton doubles SU5 (physical disability), together with Mohd Faris Ahmad Azri at the 2026 Para Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, on Wednesday (Oct 21).
